name: tlon-puzzle_force
purpose: THE PUZZLE SPEAKER, v2. Same shape as the live adapter in every respect but one: the conversation pools use all five of Tlon's speech acts instead of only `ka`. corpus_bench_force is an exact function of corpus_conv_force + corpus_conv_force_unsteered at dose 0.50, seed 20624, train.jsonl sha b3eace04 (verified byte-identical on a clean local rebuild from a different output path). Row counts are identical to the incumbent corpus_bench_dosed -- 15,225 rows, 14,921 train, 8,181 natural + 2,466 contrastive + 4,578 conversation, write 12,936 / provoke 2,289 -- so the speech-act distribution is the only live variable.
reads_on_the_box: f_local (n=64) and model_carry (CARRY_N=256), both of which now tally the FORCE the model itself chose. model_carry keeps the prior->reply table, which is the only thing that can distinguish a speaker that learned ki->ka from one that only says `ka`. ⛔ These run while the card is rented; measuring force later means buying a second box.
ip: ⛔ WITHHELD WHILE THE BOX IS LIVE. The other INSTANCE.json files in this repo carry an IP because those boxes are long dead. This one is billing as the commit lands, and ~/.tlon_env on it holds a Lambda key that can terminate any instance on the account plus an HF write token — so the repo does not advertise the SSH target. `orchestrate status` returns the IP for anyone who holds the key. Recorded locally in BOX_IP.txt, which is gitignored.
